input:
Power island interaction with GPU: after entering system suspend (STR), the Mali-G710 GPU fails to resume. The Panthor driver reports firmware not loaded after resume.

dmesg:
  [1800.100] Suspending...
  [1800.101] panthor: GPU power domain OFF (suspend)
  [1800.200] Suspend complete
  ... (resume) ...
  [3600.100] Resuming...
  [3600.101] panthor: GPU power domain ON (resume)
  [3600.102] panthor: ERROR: CSF firmware not loaded after power cycle
  [3600.103] panthor: GPU unavailable

The GPU power domain was collapsed during suspend and the firmware needs to be reloaded. This spans power management and GPU subsystems. What is the correct Panthor/CSF suspend-resume sequence?
